## Question 1

```{r}
fun2 <- function(mat) {
  n <- nrow(mat)
  k <- ncol(mat)
  ans <- mat
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 2:k) {
      ans[i,j] <- mat[i, j] + ans[i, j - 1]
    }
  }
  ans
}

fun2alt <- function(mat) {
  for (j in 2:ncol(mat)) {
    mat[, j] <- mat[, j] + mat[, j - 1]
  }
  mat
}

set.seed(2315)
dat <- matrix(rnorm(200 * 100), nrow = 200)

identical(fun2(dat), fun2alt(dat))

library(microbenchmark)
mb1 <- microbenchmark(
  fun2    = fun2(dat),
  fun2alt = fun2alt(dat),
  times   = 50L
)
print(mb1)

library(ggplot2)
autoplot(mb1) +
  labs(title = "Q1: fun2 vs fun2alt runtime comparison",
       x = "Function", y = "Time (microseconds)")
```

## Question 2

```{r}
fun3 <- function(x) {
  out <- numeric(length(x))
  cumsum_x <- 0
  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    if (x[i] == 0) {
      cumsum_x <- 0
    } else {
      cumsum_x <- cumsum_x + x[i]
    }
    out[i] <- cumsum_x
  }
  out
}

fun3alt <- function(x) {
  cs     <- cumsum(x)
  credit <- cs * (x == 0)
  cs - cummax(credit)
}

set.seed(42)
x_test <- sample(c(0, 1:5), size = 1000, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.15, rep(0.85/5, 5)))

identical(fun3(x_test), fun3alt(x_test))

set.seed(99)
x_large <- sample(c(0, 1:10), size = 100000, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.1, rep(0.9/10, 10)))

mb2 <- microbenchmark(
  fun3    = fun3(x_large),
  fun3alt = fun3alt(x_large),
  times   = 20L
)
print(mb2)

autoplot(mb2) +
  labs(title = "Q2: fun3 vs fun3alt runtime comparison",
       x = "Function", y = "Time (microseconds)")
```

## Question 3

```{r}
sim_pi <- function(n = 1000, i = NULL) {
  p <- matrix(runif(n*2), ncol = 2)
  mean(rowSums(p^2) < 1) * 4
}

set.seed(156)
sim_pi(1000)

set.seed(1231)
time_seq <- system.time({
  ans_seq <- unlist(lapply(1:4000, sim_pi, n = 10000))
  print(mean(ans_seq))
})
print(time_seq)
```

```{r}
library(parallel)

n_cores <- max(1, detectCores() - 1)
cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)
clusterExport(cl, "sim_pi")

time_par <- system.time({
  clusterSetRNGStream(cl, 1231)
  ans_par <- unlist(parLapply(cl, 1:4000, sim_pi, n = 10000))
  print(mean(ans_par))
})
stopCluster(cl)
print(time_par)
```

```{r}
df_compare <- data.frame(
  estimate = c(ans_seq, ans_par),
  method   = rep(c("Sequential", "Parallel"), each = 4000)
)

ggplot(df_compare, aes(x = estimate, fill = method)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = pi, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Q3: Distribution of pi estimates (Sequential vs Parallel)",
       x = "Estimated pi", y = "Density", fill = "Method") +
  theme_minimal()

time_df <- data.frame(
  method  = c("Sequential", "Parallel"),
  elapsed = c(time_seq["elapsed"], time_par["elapsed"])
)

ggplot(time_df, aes(x = method, y = elapsed, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(elapsed, 2), "s")), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(title = "Q3: Elapsed time - Sequential vs Parallel",
       x = "Method", y = "Elapsed Time (seconds)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# SQL

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(RSQLite)
library(DBI)

con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), ":memory:")

surveys <- read.csv("surveys.csv")
species <- read.csv("species.csv")
plots   <- read.csv("plots.csv")

dbWriteTable(con, "surveys", surveys, overwrite = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(con, "species", species, overwrite = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(con, "plots",   plots,   overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Question 4

```{sql, connection=con}
PRAGMA table_info(surveys);
```

```{sql, connection=con}
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  day,
  species_id,
  ROUND(weight / 1000.0, 2) AS weight_kg
FROM surveys
WHERE year = 1999
  AND weight IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY species_id ASC;
```

## Question 5

```{sql, connection=con}
SELECT
  SUM(weight)  AS total_weight,
  AVG(weight)  AS avg_weight,
  MIN(weight)  AS min_weight,
  MAX(weight)  AS max_weight
FROM surveys
WHERE weight IS NOT NULL;
```

```{sql, connection=con}
SELECT
  SUM(weight)  AS total_weight,
  AVG(weight)  AS avg_weight,
  MIN(weight)  AS min_weight,
  MAX(weight)  AS max_weight
FROM surveys
WHERE weight BETWEEN 5 AND 10;
```

## Question 6

```{r}
q6_result <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
    year,
    species_id,
    COUNT(*)    AS n_individuals,
    AVG(weight) AS avg_weight
  FROM surveys
  WHERE species_id IS NOT NULL
    AND species_id != ''
  GROUP BY year, species_id
  ORDER BY year, species_id
")

head(q6_result, 20)
```

## Question 7

```{sql, connection=con}
SELECT
  taxa,
  COUNT(*) AS n_species
FROM species
GROUP BY taxa
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;
```

## Question 8

```{r}
q8_result <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
    su.plot_id,
    sp.genus,
    COUNT(*) AS n_individuals
  FROM surveys su
  INNER JOIN species sp ON su.species_id = sp.species_id
  WHERE sp.genus IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.genus != ''
  GROUP BY su.plot_id, sp.genus
  ORDER BY su.plot_id ASC, n_individuals DESC
")

head(q8_result, 20)
```

## Question 9

```{sql, connection=con}
SELECT
  pl.plot_type,
  su.species_id,
  COUNT(*) AS n_caught
FROM surveys su
INNER JOIN plots pl ON su.plot_id = pl.plot_id
WHERE su.species_id IS NOT NULL
  AND su.species_id != ''
  AND su.species_id != 'NA'
GROUP BY pl.plot_type, su.species_id
ORDER BY pl.plot_type, n_caught DESC;
```

## Question 10

```{sql, connection=con}
SELECT
  su.species_id,
  sp.genus,
  sp.species,
  ROUND(AVG(su.weight), 2) AS avg_weight
FROM surveys su
INNER JOIN species sp ON su.species_id = sp.species_id
WHERE sp.taxa = 'Rodent'
  AND su.weight IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY su.species_id, sp.genus, sp.species
ORDER BY avg_weight DESC;
```

## Question 12

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)

well_sampled <- q6_result %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_weight)) %>%
  group_by(species_id) %>%
  summarise(n_years = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_years >= 10)

q6_filtered <- q6_result %>%
  filter(species_id %in% well_sampled$species_id,
         !is.na(avg_weight))

species_list <- unique(q6_filtered$species_id)

p12 <- plot_ly()

for (sp in species_list) {
  sp_data <- q6_filtered[q6_filtered$species_id == sp, ]
  sp_data <- sp_data[order(sp_data$year), ]

  p12 <- add_trace(
    p12,
    x    = sp_data$year,
    y    = sp_data$avg_weight,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers",
    name = sp,
    connectgaps = FALSE
  )
}

p12 <- layout(
  p12,
  title  = "Average Species Weight Over Time",
  xaxis  = list(title = "Year"),
  yaxis  = list(title = "Average Weight (g)"),
  legend = list(title = list(text = "Species"))
)

p12
```
